_comment: D2 kill-condition configuration (docs/d2-killcondition-results.md). Everything not listed here is INHERITED at run time from the frozen D2 pilot config (experiments/liveness/d2/pilot-config.json) and from baselines/w1_b0_b2/w1-config.json + baselines/b3_eval/b3-eval-config.json, so the two phases share the same chain, W1 and B3 parameters by construction rather than by copy. Values under `overrides` replace an inherited value and must state why. Both config digests are written into the batch manifest. Changing a value after a result is reported requires a docs/decision-log.md entry.

d2a.bootstrap_call_gas_limit.why: The contention experiments run on a FAN-OUT deployment, where one frozen CreditPool.deposit additionally forwards the new root to the frozen CreditPaymaster and to one HistoryCreditPaymaster per tested K (7 targets). That is a harness cost, not a protocol cost, and it raises the Bootstrap's execution gas above the pilot's experimental 1,000,000. Like the pilot's value this is a wallet-side parameter, never the frozen 160,000 baseline and never a proposed fix; it still respects BootstrapPaymaster's frozen 0.005 ETH cap at the W1 fee (sum of gas limits x 2 gwei ~= 0.0032 ETH). No gas number in the result document is taken from a fan-out deployment.

preregistered_thresholds._comment: Recorded in docs/decision-log.md BEFORE the final matrix was collected (Section 12 of the phase brief). 'Negligible' is defined here, not after seeing results. The DENOMINATORS were made explicit after a reduced smoke run (1 seed, K in {1,4,32}, tree sizes <= 15) showed that 'overhead < x%' is ambiguous without one; the percentages themselves were not changed. See the decision-log entry of 2026-09-16.
preregistered_thresholds.stale_failure_metric: upper end of the Wilson 95% interval of the measured stale-root failure rate, pooled over all cells with 0 < lambda*T <= stale_failure_region_max_lambda_T
preregistered_thresholds.validation_overhead_metric: (UserOperation actualGasUsed of a real included Spend with this variant - the same quantity for the frozen CreditPaymaster) / the frozen quantity, on dedicated deployments at the same pool size and proof depth
preregistered_thresholds.root_update_overhead_metric: max over tested tree sizes of (Bootstrap UserOperation actualGasUsed with this variant - the same quantity for the frozen CreditPaymaster) / the frozen quantity. The whole sponsored operation is the denominator because that is what the sponsor pays; the CreditPool.deposit-frame fraction is reported alongside it and is always the larger of the two.
preregistered_thresholds.bounded_storage_metric: steady-state non-zero storage slots of the Paymaster's root history (2K + 1 by construction, checked by contracts/d2k/test/HistoryRoots.t.sol)

boundary._comment: Section 13: deterministic simulation -> inclusion race with an exact number of intervening root updates. Every variant is tested against the SAME intervening Bootstraps on the same chain.

security._comment: Section 6: security invariants with real Groth16 proofs against the real frozen SemaphoreVerifier.

stochastic._comment: Sections 9/10. Pool size is fixed at 16: the pilot measured no pool-size effect on D2-A (b2 = -0.008 +- 0.042). Every variant replays the SAME seeded arrival stream for the same trial index (common random numbers, paired).

retry._comment: Section 10: retries / proofs / simulations / time to success per K, with the frozen bundler policy P0 and the pilot's retry cap.

bundle._comment: Section 14: bundle sizes sharing one proof root, with 0..K+1 intervening root updates, plus one stale operation in an otherwise valid bundle. EntryPoint bundling is NOT redesigned.

overhead._comment: Section 11. DEDICATED deployments only (one frozen CreditPool -> one Paymaster), never the fan-out. Root-update overhead is measured on a growing real tree; validation overhead on real included Spends with real proofs. spend_pool_size is a MINIMUM: the Spend is measured on the tree left by the root-update sweep (max(tree_sizes) + 1 members), so every variant proves at the same depth over the same members.

d2b_decomposition._comment: Sections 16-19. G0 is the FROZEN CreditPool.deposit frame inside a REAL sponsored Bootstrap UserOperation -- the same quantity, measured the same way (callTracer sub-frame), as the frozen D2 pilot's D2-B table -- so the decomposition is anchored to a reproduction of frozen behaviour before anything is attributed. G1..G5 are frames inside a BenchRunner call, so every G-series number is a CALL sub-frame and no intrinsic-gas or calldata accounting enters a comparison. record_sizes are the sizes shown in the document; bootstrap_check_sizes additionally get a frozen-callGasLimit feasibility probe inside a reverted snapshot.

frozen_envelope._comment: Sections 20 and 23. The frozen callGasLimit is read from baselines/b3_eval/b3-eval-config.json at run time (never copied here). high_call_gas_limit is an EXPERIMENTAL measurement-mode value, never reported as frozen B3.

grant._comment: Section 21. Controlled failed Bootstraps on the FROZEN B3 deployment, with full before/after state.
